commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Of all who stand in sin because of desire, none are as foolish as those who love another man’s wife and stand at his door. Sinners who follow women, or go with prostitutes or women of low family, lose righteousness and wealth. Those at another’s door lose even the pleasure they sought, through fear. So they have no pleasure either.
